$schema: Datum family app summary, read by the Datum hub site (github.com/Edgar-Mendonca/Datum) and by Help › Roadmap in the app.
name: Datum Atlas
tagline: Choose the right material: property charts, selection and referenced data, in one app for Windows.
for: Design and materials engineers, and students.
about: Datum Atlas helps you pick a material and show why it is the right one. Choose a design goal, such as a light, stiff beam or a cheap, strong tie, and Atlas sets the property chart, the selection line and the limits for you.

Every material is a bubble spanning its range of values, grouped by family. Limits, index lines, bands, boxes, drawn shapes and whole families left out narrow the field; the materials that pass are ranked, by one index or by weighted properties, and every one that fails says why. Compare the best side by side and print a report. Every value names its source, and you can add, import and share your own materials.

steps.title: Pick a goal
steps.text: Choose a design goal, or set the two properties to chart yourself.

steps.title: Chart and select
steps.text: Move the selection line, add limits and boxes, and watch the field narrow.

steps.title: Rank, compare and report
steps.text: See the materials that pass, ranked. Compare the best side by side, then print the selection report or send the results to a spreadsheet.

highlights: About 250 materials from every family, compiled from open and public sources. Every value names its source; 73 values are checked against published datasheets so far, and gaps stay gaps, never zero.
Property charts of any two properties or of your own formulas, with family envelopes, zoom, pan, the best materials labelled and labels kept apart; bar charts; up to four charts side by side.
25 design goals and a library of 47 performance indices, with an index builder; a goal sets the axes, the selection line and the limits in one pick, and explains why.
Selection by limits, index lines, bands, boxes, drawn shapes and families; results ranked by an index or by weighted properties, with the reason every other material fails.
Compare up to six materials in a table and a radar chart, and print a selection report with the charts, the shortlist and the datasheets.
Your own materials and formula properties; import from a spreadsheet or CSV, open a colleague's database, and export results and materials to a spreadsheet. SI or imperial units everywhere.

roadmap.title: Eco and process
items: Energy and CO₂ across a product's life, and greener substitutes.

roadmap.title: Stable
items: About 1,000 materials, a user guide and a signed installer.
